Typography

round(16 x 1.333^n): 12, 16, 21, 28, 38, 51, 67, 90px. Weights body 400, label 500, heading 750, display 850.

display.sm 90/100 850One hero line per page: marketing, empty states.
headline.lg 67/76 750Page and section titles.
headline.md 51/56 750Page and section titles.
headline.sm 38/48 750Page and section titles.
title.lg 28/36 750Card, panel and group titles.
body.lg 21/28 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 21/28 750Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 16/24 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 16/24 500Button and control labels.
code.md 16/24 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 16/24 750Table headers, field-group titles.
body.sm 12/16 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 12/16 500Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 12/16 500Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 12/16 400Inline values, dense code rows.
